description: This file defines an enumeration 'LocalizedFormats' used for managing localized message formats in exception handling within the Apache Commons Math library. Each enum constant represents a specific error message format, often with placeholders for parameters, and supports retrieving localized message strings based on locale. The class includes methods for obtaining the source (English) string and localized strings, loading resource bundles for translation.

classes.name: LocalizedFormats
classes.description: Enumeration for localized message formats used in exception messages. Implements 'Localizable' interface, providing methods to get source and localized strings.

methods.name: getSourceString
methods.description: Returns the default English format string associated with the enum constant.

methods.name: getLocalizedString
methods.description: Attempts to retrieve a locale-specific translation of the message format using resource bundles; falls back to the source string if translation is unavailable.
